title: DrawerForm's no-sections field builder drops `visibleWhen` / `readonlyWhen` / `requiredWhen` (and `group`) — ModalForm's identical builder carries them
body:
Found while implementing #4085 (the `requiredWhen` + runtime-`defaultValue` create-form deadlock). Filed unassigned and deliberately out of that card's scope — it is a different bug on a neighbouring line.

## The asymmetry

`ModalForm` and `DrawerForm` each carry a *flat* field builder for the case where the caller supplies `objectName` (or `fields`) but no `sections` and no `customFields`. The two builders are otherwise line-for-line the same auto-generated `FormField`. One carries the ADR-0036 field-level conditional rules through to the renderer; the other does not.

`packages/plugin-form/src/ModalForm.tsx` (~:423, inside the no-sections `useEffect`) ends with:

```ts
        options: field.options,
        multiple: field.multiple,
        // Field-level conditional rules (ADR-0036) — resolved reactively by
        // the form renderer via the canonical engine (#2212).
        visibleWhen: (field as any).visibleWhen,
        readonlyWhen: (field as any).readonlyWhen,
        requiredWhen: (field as any).requiredWhen,
        // Field-group membership (Field.group → object.fieldGroups[].key) —
        // read by deriveFieldGroupSections for the fieldGroups fallback.
        group: (field as any).group,
```

`packages/plugin-form/src/DrawerForm.tsx` (~:348, the same `useEffect`) stops at `multiple: field.multiple,` — no `visibleWhen`, no `readonlyWhen`, no `requiredWhen`, no `group`.

Verified on `origin/main` @ `2e82ab2ae`:

```
$ git grep -n "requiredWhen\|visibleWhen" -- packages/plugin-form/src/DrawerForm.tsx
(no output)
$ git grep -n "requiredWhen" -- packages/plugin-form/src/ModalForm.tsx
435:        requiredWhen: (field as any).requiredWhen,
```

`SplitForm` and `TabbedForm` are NOT affected — they have no flat builder at all and always route through `sectionFields.ts`, whose `fromObjectSchema` carries all three (`packages/plugin-form/src/sectionFields.ts:131-133`). So the gap is exactly one file.

## Effect

A drawer form opened over an object whose fields declare conditional rules ignores every one of them: a `visibleWhen`-FALSE field renders anyway, a `readonlyWhen`-TRUE field stays editable (and the server then strips the write and reports `droppedFields`), and a `requiredWhen` predicate never fires. The renderer is not at fault — `resolveFieldRuleState` never receives the predicates, because the builder did not copy them onto the runtime `FormField`.

The dropped `group` has a second effect: `deriveFieldGroupSections`'s `fieldGroups` fallback has nothing to group on, so a drawer form cannot auto-derive sections from the object's declared field groups the way the modal can.

## Not measured

I did not measure a shipped app that opens a drawer form with no `sections` over an object declaring conditional rules — the #4085 work only needed the sectioned path, so this was found by reading the sibling builders side by side rather than from a report. Filing plainly for triage to grade rather than sitting on it; severity judged at filing time is unreliable in both directions.

## Fix shape (not attempted here)

Copy the four keys onto `DrawerForm`'s generated field, matching `ModalForm`. The durable version is to stop maintaining two hand-copied builders: both are the same "object schema field to runtime FormField" mapping that `sectionFields.ts`'s `fromObjectSchema` already implements and keeps current — that is where the #3986 widget-arity fix, the #4069 create-mode `required` rule and the ADR-0036 rules all landed once. A parity test over the three producers would catch the next divergence, which is how this one survived: nothing asserts that the flat builders agree with the sectioned one.
